Method of Attack: Compromise of website by injecting malicious JavaScript scripts to steal payment information submitted by customers
Injection of obfuscated Magecart script into https://www.macys.com/js/min/common/util/ClientSideErrorLog.js
Malicious script sends stolen payment data to command and control server
Discoverer: Anonymous researcher who reported to Macy's
Attack Vector: Injection of malicious JavaScript into checkout and wallet pages on Macys.com
